recommendation: Keep the no-change audit commit. No core follow-up is needed unless a future generated artifact or validator report identifies an active Vital Signs StructureDefinition.name that again contains whitespace.

initial_application: No current-source commit explicitly names FHIR-19774. Historical evidence shows the whitespace-bearing name in old STU3 release-history material, while official R4 vitalsigns.profile.xml already uses <name value="observation-vitalsigns"/> with <title value="Vital Signs Profile"/>; later git history includes profile-name maintenance such as FHIR-37449 changing the active source name to Observationvitalsigns before subsequent vital-signs refactoring renamed the base profile to Observationvitalsignsbase.
additional_context: source/fhir.ini actively maps Observation=observation and the Observation vital-signs IG references StructureDefinition/vitalsigns, so the checked source is in current build scope. Current source/observation/structuredefinition-profile-vitalsigns.xml uses name Observationvitalsignsbase and title Vital Signs Base Profile; a current scan of Observation profile primary names found no whitespace-bearing StructureDefinition.name values. The linked Zulip thread confirms the original defect, and Confluence references list FHIR-19774 in OO tracker/project pages without a conflicting current-source decision.
reconciliation: Published an empty audit commit because the current core source and checked R4/R5 publication surfaces already satisfy the issue: the invalid whitespace-bearing computable name is absent, and a source edit would only disturb later valid profile-name refactors.
